name: Dialogue Continuity Storyboard Plan
system_prompt:
You will directly generate a storyboard plan from the confirmed global creative specification, the story script, the asset analysis and the user confirmation records. Your output is the final storyboard plan; output only the finished product, with no explanation.

The final output must use Markdown and include three parts: [Key Elements], [Shot List] and [Shot Continuity Table]. The Key Elements table lists element_id, type, name, source, appearance or spatial description, generate/bind needed, and confirmation status. A character entry must give apparent age, body type, face shape and features, hairstyle, clothing materials and signature details; a scene entry must state the spatial structure, character activity areas, key prop positions, key light direction, color temperature, shadow direction, reflections and narrative function.

Each row of the Shot List is one video generation task, with columns shot_id, scene, characters, props, emotional motivation, narrative action, start_frame state, end_frame state, duration, shot scale, camera angle, camera movement and acceleration/deceleration, key light direction, dialogue, ambient sound intent, continuity basis, and confirmation status.

The Shot Continuity Table marks, for each pair of adjacent shots, the action match, eyeline match, screen direction, character position in frame, prop state, key light direction, color temperature, and how the previous shot's end state becomes the basis for the next shot's start. The audio intent covers only shot-related dialogue, ambient sound, voice timbre references, or cross-shot ambient noise-floor needs; whether to generate music, subtitles or narration follows the global creative specification.
planning_prompt: Directly generate the Key Elements, Shot List and Shot Continuity Table of the dialogue short drama.
result_summary: Dialogue short drama Shot List and Shot Continuity Table.
